title: Keys on the tom channel

complaints.says: When I hit my tom, the Keys meter jumps.
And my keys show up on the Tom fader.

win.label: Keys on the Keys channel
win.hint: The Keys DI XLR is in Stagebox In 9 and the Tom XLR is in In 7. Move each back to its own input.

win.label: No tom on the Keys channel

hints: Two sources traded places. Follow each XLR from the stage to the stagebox.
cause: The Keys DI and Tom mic XLRs were plugged into each other's stagebox inputs.
lesson: Label both ends of every cable and keep an input list at the stagebox. Swapped inputs are easy to spot when one source moves another channel's meter.
